method.lines: wc -l semantics: count the \n bytes in each file. Files are .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.html under src/ and shell/src/, plus install.sh and shell/bin/install; exclude directories named __tests__/ or test/ and the vendored src/observatory/web/three.bundle.js. Area is src/<first dir> or shell/src/<first dir>; files directly in src/ or shell/src/ form the areas src and shell/src; install.sh and shell/bin/install are their own areas. Dev tooling (scripts/, shell/scripts/), evals (eval/, evals/), docs and data files are not product code.
method.tools: Distinct names registered by the eight default tool plugins returned by defaultPlugins() in shell/src/app.ts: builtin-tools (read, write, edit, bash), proposal, credential, ask, assignment, memory-tool, soul-edit, self-install (propose_plugin, plugin_proposal_status, installed_plugins). Native plugins loaded from the user registry and channel tools are not counted.
method.commands: Entries of CORE_COMMANDS in shell/src/commands.ts, counted as lines matching ^    name: '<name>',$ inside that array.
method.tables: Entries with type "table" in FINAL_TABLES plus FINAL_AUXILIARY_OBJECTS of src/migrations/v3_7_4/FinalSchemaDefinition.ts. Indexes, triggers and views are not tables.
method.exportSymbols: Named exports of the package public entry point src/public.ts as resolved by the TypeScript checker, including export * barrels and type-only exports.
